messages.body:
Hi Myriam,
Give this a try:
This is my script:

startframe=1, endframe=5000, interval=10,verbose=2, keep_files=0,
*use_sander=1,*
/
&gb
igb=5, saltcon=0.150,
/
&decomp
idecomp=3, dec_verbose=1,csv_format=0,
print_res="1-137",
